description: This Java class manages persistent configuration data for an application. It provides functionality to load and save configuration settings to an XML file, and allows retrieval of the root configuration node.

classes.name: PersistentConfiguration
classes.description: Singleton class that handles loading and saving of configuration data to an XML file, maintaining it in a map structure.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PersistentConfiguration.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from an XML file into memory.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current configuration data from memory into an XML file.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Retrieves the root configuration node based on current config data.
